newsitem.title: GREECE: UNCLE STATHIS SEES 12-15PCT GROWTH IN 97.
newsitem.headline: UNCLE STATHIS SEES 12-15PCT GROWTH IN 97.

text.p: General Foods , formerly Uncle Stathis SA, expects earnings and sales growth of 12-15 percent this year, the firm's managing director Dimitris Takkas told shareholders at the annual meeting.
In 1996 the company posted pretax profit of 719 million versus 304 million a year earlier and will pay a dividend oper share of 60 drachmas both for common and preferred shares.
Board chairman Costas Nikolaidis told shareholders the company plans to entter into new frozen food markets beyond vegetables and dough.
It will seek to increase its sales abroad to 15 percent of total turnover from 10 percent currently. --George Georgiopoulos, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
